headlines.title: Judge blocks construction on Trump’s D.C.-area arch after commission’s approval
headlines.description: The Trump administration has said it expects to begin construction immediately, but a judge is considering a plan to temporarily halt the project.

headlines.title: Democratic socialist Nithya Raman defeats Karen Bass in the L.A. mayor’s race
headlines.description: NBC News projects the progressive City Council member has unseated Bass, a fixture of California Democratic politics who served one term as mayor.

headlines.title: Gov. Gavin Newsom Commutes All 548 California Death Sentences
headlines.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 inmates on the state’s death row. Those prisoners will now receive a sentence of life in prison without the possibility of parole.

headlines.title: Head of DOJ Civil Rights Division resigns after GOP midterms loss
headlines.description: Harmeet Dhillon, the outspoken and sometimes controversial head of the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division, submitted her resignation after the GOP midterms loss. NBC News’ Gary Grumbach details her time in office.

headlines.title: Nithya Raman Defeats Karen Bass in Los Angeles Mayor’s Race
headlines.description: City Council member Nithya Raman has defeated incumbent Karen Bass in the Los Angeles mayoral race. The result now puts Democratic Socialists in control of the country’s two largest cities, New York and LA.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Pete Hegseth strikes defiant tone in face of impeachment threat
headlines.description: Many lawmakers, including some Republicans, have criticized the defense secretary over his handling of the Iran war.

headlines.title: Rep. Ro Khanna allies launch a draft campaign for the 2028 presidential race
headlines.description: Exclusive: The California congressman has been traveling the country and building prominence among progressives.

headlines.title: Sizing up the blue wave: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Democrats are on track for the second-biggest House popular vote edge in the last 50 years. This will also be the largest midterm margin for one party since 1974.

headlines.title: Head of DOJ Civil Rights Division resigns after GOP midterms loss
headlines.description: Harmeet Dhillon oversaw a massive overhaul of the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division, targeting universities and focusing on culture war issues.

headlines.title: Justice Department moves to toss Steve Bannon’s conviction tied to Congress’ Jan. 6 investigation
headlines.description: The administration “harbors significant doubts” about the trial’s fairness, a top official said in a court filing.
